queryLines:

datasets.name: brent_transmission
queryLines:
SELECT
  *
FROM
  workspace.banknifty_macro.gold_brent_feature_importance
WHERE
  feature LIKE '%Brent%CPI%'
  OR feature LIKE '%Brent%USDINR%'
  OR feature LIKE '%Brent%Policy%Rate%'
  OR (
    feature LIKE '%Brent%'
    AND feature LIKE '%lag%'
  )
ORDER BY
  importance DESC

datasets.name: feature_importance
queryLines:
SELECT
  *
FROM
  workspace.banknifty_macro.gold_feature_importance
ORDER BY
  importance DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: mlflow_model_comparison
queryLines:
SELECT
  r.run_id,
  COALESCE(r.tags['mlflow.runName'], r.run_name) as model_name,
  r.start_time,
  r.end_time,
  r.status,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN m.metric_name = 'mae' THEN m.metric_value
    END
  ) as mae,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN m.metric_name = 'rmse' THEN m.metric_value
    END
  ) as rmse,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN m.metric_name = 'r2' THEN m.metric_value
    END
  ) as r2,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN m.metric_name = 'directional_accuracy' THEN m.metric_value
    END
  ) as directional_accuracy
FROM
  system.mlflow.runs_latest r
    LEFT JOIN system.mlflow.run_metrics_history m
      ON r.run_id = m.run_id
WHERE
  r.experiment_id = '2601105451353852'
  AND r.delete_time IS NULL
  AND (
    m.metric_name IN ('mae', 'rmse', 'r2', 'directional_accuracy')
    OR m.metric_name IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY
  r.run_id,
  r.run_name,
  r.start_time,
  r.end_time,
  r.status,
  r.tags
ORDER BY
  r.start_time DESC

datasets.name: macro_time_series
queryLines:

  Brent_USD_bbl,

  India_CPI_YoY_Pct,
  India_Policy_Rate_Pct,
  India_10Y_GSec_Yield_Pct,
  US10Y_Yield_Pct,
  India_Real_GDP_YoY_Pct,
  India_Bank_Credit_Growth_YoY_Pct,

queryLines:
